title: Battle of Hatchōoki
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Hatchōoki", at revision 1370265443, opens: "The Battle of Hatchōoki  was an ambush in the middle of the Battle of Hokuetsu in the Boshin War by forces of Nagaoka Domain on forces loyal to the Imperial Court. The battle occurred in what is now the city of Nagaoka, in Niigata Prefecture." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11390454, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1868 ambush in the Boshin War in Japan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
